name: BlossomVR
summary:
Relax in virtual reality through minigames and mindfulness with BlossomVR! Utilize a suite of minigames to let out you anger, explore your creativity, or just enjoy the view.
BlossomVR currently features the following suite of minigames:
--- Punch Bag: Let your anger out with a virtual punching bag, and knock down wooden blocks with rocks and lasers.
--- Fishing: chill and enjoy a great view while catching fish
--- Cooking: let your creativity (and stomach) guide you as you design your ideal pizza
--- Sound
